answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 44251 Country: India Title: tax deducted at source Question: I am a government employee and my tax is deducted at source i.e. in my salary. Can by niyat (intention) I use the interest money of my bank account as a compensation for the tax deducted directly from my salary. I have read that interest money can be used for paying the tax but in my case tax is directly being deducted from my salary. Answer ID: 44251 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 564/459/B=1434) One can pay the interest money in non-Shariah taxes; it is allowable as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
